saw_lines: Card players buy for one format at a time and click only when they know what their deck still lacks.
So the sale is won in line one, where a tournament date or set name must match the player’s deck.
Your 5 of 12 copy ads open on one Modern question, so one opener carries the account. Run three new openers from your own range, each tested against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 19 Oct 2026
points: 5 of 12 copy ads open on “Dein Modern-Deck ist bereit?”, so one question carries the account and misses buyers with other needs. Run three new openers from your own range, such as the Alpha Full Set, each tested against it.
One exact copy runs in 5 of 12 ads, so the same words repeat across five ads and each new buyer meets one pitch. Keep the body text but change the opening line and creative in every variant.

None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a first-time buyer has no number to trust before clicking. Collect one figure you can stand behind, like your review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.
18 of your 30 ads are catalog feed ads with no story, so a player sees a product grid and nothing to stop for. Add three story ads, such as a Hof tournament preview, that give the feed a reason.
